items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from hamstring; listed questionable but took starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week, no setbacks, starter reps.
items.implication: Upgrade for Bears pass catchers (Odunze, Moore, Loveland, Burden); start Williams as QB1/2.
items.opportunity: Full snap share and red-zone looks return.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot; out for foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start Sunday and moving forward. Signed RB Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Blood clot in calf after doctor consultations Saturday.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles pass-catchers (Smith, Goedert, Wicks) face QB downgrade but remain viable; long-term Hurts absence.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for backups and pass game volume under McKee if offense stays pass-heavy.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Jets.
items.why: Returned to practice this week after high-ankle sprain.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/3 start; high target share expected in return.
items.opportunity: Primary target opportunity vs Jets secondary.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled out (hamstring) for Eagles Week 6; multiple sources and reports confirm alongside Hurts IR.
items.implication: RBBC or Dameon Pierce/Jaydon Blue lead; major downgrade for Eagles run game.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.implication: Potential target share addition with Lamar out; monitor for role.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets in depleted Ravens WR room.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee everywhere available as QB; will be better than expected and Eagles skill players remain startable with him. Not worried about top pass-catchers.
items.why: McKee can play; Eagles offense not collapsing.
items.implication: Stream McKee; start Smith/Goedert as usual or slight dock.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots, starting him as WR2 wherever rostered.
items.implication: Strong WR2 play in return spot.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled out (ankle) for Ravens vs Browns; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.opportunity: Slight uptick possible for Flowers in volume but lower efficiency.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) for Chiefs Week 6 per comprehensive reports and prior ETR-style lists.
items.why: Hamstring from prior week; bye insufficient.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Xavier Worthy and remaining WRs.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Jets; confirmed across injury reports.
items.implication: Backup RBs (Isaiah Davis etc) get work; Wilson still primary pass option.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) for Texans in London; confirmed on official reports.
items.implication: Woody Marks or others lead backfield.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Routes and red-zone vs weak coverage.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage.
Loves George Kittle vs WSH (TE3) as Commanders defense nightmare for TEs.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and leaking run defense.
Loves Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8) for goal-line role and volume vs leaking defense.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
Hates Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34) for lack of recent targets and tough spot.
